title: A continuous integral cokernel of locally constant scalar type has constant local models
statement: Fix a finite extension E of Q_l, and let A be its latticeCoefficientIntegers subring with valuation topology. For any scheme map p:Y→X and a single finite free presentation f over p^*p_X^*C(-,A), suppose its full scalar cokernel class function on Y is locally constant. Then extension of scalars of coker f along the canonical coefficient pullback isomorphism has finite constant local models over p_Y^*C(-,A). No Noetherianity, compatible presentation family or descent hypothesis is assumed; torsion and zero sizes are included.

source.place: Example 3.1; parent comparison proof steps 2--5; for local Smith, Theorem 6.12(2) pivot/division argument.

proof.text: Local constancy of the skeleton class gives neighborhoods with isomorphic ordinary scalar cokernels, by the quotient definition of the skeleton. Identify the lattice WithAbs subring with the original spectral valuation ring. Their valuation and maximal-ideal-adic topologies agree, since positive powers of a uniformizer are a neighborhood basis. Transport the continuous matrix and its scalar quotient isomorphisms across this ring homeomorphism.

Apply continuous integral matrix local Smith form on each such neighborhood. Transport its continuous invertible row and column matrices back to A. Their pointwise inverses give sheaf automorphisms of finite free modules, and LFR=D identifies the presentation cokernel with that of a fixed scalar diagonal. The generic restriction comparison and its monoidal compatibility from the continuous-matrix sheaf interface identify matrix pullback with restriction of continuous functions.

Construct on the point the finite free morphism with scalar matrix D, and take its cokernel P. It is finitely presented by definition. Pullback from the point preserves its cokernel, giving the diagonal presentation on the open. Coefficient change preserves cokernels and transports the original presentation. The open-immersion cover is a pro-etale cover and gives the required models, including empty schemes and empty matrices.

proof_origin.place: Detailed proof of the corresponding part of lem-sfb-integral-lfp-constant-model-comparison; explicit universe-polymorphic coefficient construction.

theorem integral_cokernel_hasFiniteConstantLocalModel
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) {m n : ℕ}
    (f : Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).obj
      (baseCoeff (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E) X)) m ⟶
      Mod.finiteFree ((upperStar Ab.{u + 1} p).obj
      (baseCoeff (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E) X)) n)
    (h : IsLocallyConstant (presentationFiberType (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E) p f)) :
    HasFiniteConstantLocalModel
      (baseRing (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E)) Y
      ((Mod.extendScalars (condensedPullbackHom
        (baseRing (latticeCoefficientIntegers l E)) p)).obj
          (cokernel f))
